items.question: Trong câu "Scrum separates three responsibilities: WHAT (Product Owner), HOW (the development team), and PROCESS (Scrum Master).", từ "separate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scrum separates three responsibilities: WHAT (Product Owner), HOW (the development team), and PROCESS (Scrum Master).", what does "separate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (động từ): tách riêng, phân chia. "Separate A from B" = tách A khỏi B; tính từ "separate" /ˈseprət/ = riêng biệt.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (verb): to divide into distinct parts. "Separate A from B" keeps them apart; the adjective "separate" means distinct.

items.question: Trong câu "Scrum separates three responsibilities: WHAT (Product Owner), HOW (the development team), and PROCESS (Scrum Master).", từ "responsibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scrum separates three responsibilities: WHAT (Product Owner), HOW (the development team), and PROCESS (Scrum Master).", what does "responsibility" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a duty you are in charge of
items.explanation: responsibility /rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm. "Take responsibility for X" = chịu trách nhiệm về X.
items.explanationEn: responsibility /rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti/ (noun): a duty you are in charge of. "Take responsibility for X" means accept that X is your duty.

items.question: Trong câu "That person will let themselves cut technical corners to meet a commitment they made themselves.", từ "cut corners" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That person will let themselves cut technical corners to meet a commitment they made themselves.", what does "cut corners" (phrase) mean?
options: cắt giảm chi phí hợp lý
optionsEn: to skip proper steps to save time
items.explanation: cut corners /kʌt ˈkɔːnəz/ (cụm từ): làm tắt, ẩu để kịp. "Cut corners" = làm ẩu, bỏ qua bước cần thiết để nhanh hơn; mang nghĩa tiêu cực.
items.explanationEn: cut corners /kʌt ˈkɔːnəz/ (phrase): to skip proper steps to save time. "Cut corners" means doing something badly to save time; it is negative.

items.question: Trong câu "That person will let themselves cut technical corners to meet a commitment they made themselves.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That person will let themselves cut technical corners to meet a commitment they made themselves.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪtmənt/ (danh từ): cam kết. "Meet a commitment" = thực hiện đúng cam kết; "make a commitment" = đưa ra cam kết.
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪtmənt/ (noun): a promise to do something. "Meet a commitment" means deliver what you promised; you "make a commitment".

items.question: Trong câu "Three boundaries worth memorising:", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three boundaries worth memorising:", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Clear boundaries between roles" = ranh giới rõ ràng giữa các vai trò.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): a dividing line between areas. "Clear boundaries between roles" define where one role ends.

items.question: Trong câu "Three boundaries worth memorising:", từ "memorise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three boundaries worth memorising:", what does "memorise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorise /ˈmeməraɪz/ (động từ): ghi nhớ thuộc lòng. "Worth memorising" = đáng ghi nhớ; chính tả Mỹ là "memorize".
items.explanationEn: memorise /ˈmeməraɪz/ (verb): to learn by heart. "Worth memorising" means worth learning by heart; US spelling is "memorize".

items.question: Trong câu "Scrum Master — but supporting, never commanding", từ "command" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scrum Master — but supporting, never commanding", what does "command" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: command /kəˈmɑːnd/ (động từ): ra lệnh, chỉ huy. Scrum Master hỗ trợ chứ không ra lệnh; danh từ "command" trong IT là câu lệnh.
items.explanationEn: command /kəˈmɑːnd/ (verb): to give orders. The Scrum Master supports rather than gives orders; in IT, a "command" is an instruction.

items.question: Trong câu "That invades the team's authority.", từ "invade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That invades the team's authority.", what does "invade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invade /ɪnˈveɪd/ (động từ): xâm phạm. "Invade someone's authority/privacy" = xâm phạm quyền/quyền riêng tư của ai.
items.explanationEn: invade /ɪnˈveɪd/ (verb): to intrude on. "Invade someone's authority" means intrude on what they control.

items.question: Trong câu "the team says how much is feasible.", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the team says how much is feasible.", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiːzəbl/ (tính từ): khả thi. "Technically feasible" = khả thi về kỹ thuật; danh từ "feasibility".
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiːzəbl/ (adjective): possible to do. "Technically feasible" means it can be done; the noun is "feasibility".

items.question: Trong câu "The PO stays for the whole session to answer questions as the team breaks work down.", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO stays for the whole session to answer questions as the team breaks work down.", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ. "Break work down into tasks" = chia việc thành các task; "the car broke down" = xe bị hỏng.
items.explanationEn: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (phrase): to divide into smaller parts. "Break work down into tasks" means split it; "the car broke down" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO does NOT decide how much the team takes, and does NOT assign work to individuals.", từ "assign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO does NOT decide how much the team takes, and does NOT assign work to individuals.", what does "assign" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a task to someone
items.explanation: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): giao, phân công. "Assign a task to someone" = giao việc cho ai; "assignee" = người được giao.
items.explanationEn: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to give a task to someone. "Assign a task to someone" gives it to them; the "assignee" receives it.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO does NOT decide how much the team takes, and does NOT assign work to individuals.", từ "individual" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO does NOT decide how much the team takes, and does NOT assign work to individuals.", what does "individual" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: individual /ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəl/ (danh từ): cá nhân. Trái với "team"; tính từ "individual" = riêng lẻ.
items.explanationEn: individual /ˌɪndɪˈvɪdʒuəl/ (noun): a single person. The opposite of a team; the adjective "individual" means single, separate.

items.question: Trong câu "A sign of a poorly prepared PO: planning runs long because the team keeps asking questions that should have been answered in refinement.", từ "poorly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sign of a poorly prepared PO: planning runs long because the team keeps asking questions that should have been answered in refinement.", what does "poorly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: poorly /ˈpɔːli/ (trạng từ): kém, không tốt. "Poorly prepared/designed" = chuẩn bị/thiết kế kém.
items.explanationEn: poorly /ˈpɔːli/ (adverb): badly, not well. "Poorly prepared" means badly prepared.

items.question: Trong câu "A sign of a poorly prepared PO: planning runs long because the team keeps asking questions that should have been answered in refinement.", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sign of a poorly prepared PO: planning runs long because the team keeps asking questions that should have been answered in refinement.", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
options: buổi làm rõ, tinh chỉnh backlog
optionsEn: the process of clarifying backlog items
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (danh từ): buổi làm rõ, tinh chỉnh backlog. "Backlog refinement" = làm rõ và chia nhỏ hạng mục trước khi lập kế hoạch sprint.
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (noun): the process of clarifying backlog items. "Backlog refinement" clarifies and splits items before sprint planning.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO need not attend.", từ "attend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO need not attend.", what does "attend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attend /əˈtend/ (động từ): tham dự. "Attend a meeting" (không có "to") = tham dự cuộc họp; "attend to" = xử lý, chăm lo.
items.explanationEn: attend /əˈtend/ (verb): to be present at. "Attend a meeting" takes no "to"; "attend to something" means deal with it.

items.question: Trong câu "If present, the PO listens to hear impediments, rather than turning it into a status report for themselves.", từ "impediment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If present, the PO listens to hear impediments, rather than turning it into a status report for themselves.", what does "impediment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impediment /ɪmˈpedɪmənt/ (danh từ): trở ngại. Thuật ngữ Scrum: điều cản trở nhóm làm việc; "remove impediments" = gỡ trở ngại.
items.explanationEn: impediment /ɪmˈpedɪmənt/ (noun): an obstacle. A Scrum term for anything blocking the team; the SM helps "remove impediments".

items.question: Trong câu "The main value of attending: hearing a problem the same day and answering business questions on the spot.", từ "on the spot" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The main value of attending: hearing a problem the same day and answering business questions on the spot.", what does "on the spot" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on the spot /ɒn ðə spɒt/ (cụm từ): ngay lập tức, tại chỗ. "Answer on the spot" = trả lời ngay tại chỗ; "put someone on the spot" = đẩy ai vào thế khó.
items.explanationEn: on the spot /ɒn ðə spɒt/ (phrase): immediately, right there. "Answer on the spot" means immediately; "put someone on the spot" means embarrass them.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO invites real stakeholders — a review without real users is only an internal demo.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO invites real stakeholders — a review without real users is only an internal demo.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜːnl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. "Internal demo/tool" = bản demo/công cụ chỉ dùng trong nội bộ.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜːnl/ (adjective): within an organisation. "An internal demo" is shown only inside the organisation.

items.question: Trong câu "But carefully: if the team will not speak frankly with the PO present, ask the Scrum Master and accept being absent from some sessions.", từ "frankly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But carefully: if the team will not speak frankly with the PO present, ask the Scrum Master and accept being absent from some sessions.", what does "frankly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: frankly /ˈfræŋkli/ (trạng từ): thẳng thắn. "Speak frankly" = nói thẳng; "frankly speaking" = nói thật thì.
items.explanationEn: frankly /ˈfræŋkli/ (adverb): honestly and openly. "Speak frankly" means speak honestly; "frankly speaking" opens an honest opinion.

items.question: Trong câu "But carefully: if the team will not speak frankly with the PO present, ask the Scrum Master and accept being absent from some sessions.", từ "absent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But carefully: if the team will not speak frankly with the PO present, ask the Scrum Master and accept being absent from some sessions.", what does "absent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absent /ˈæbsənt/ (tính từ): vắng mặt. "Be absent from a session" = vắng mặt; "absent-minded" = đãng trí (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: absent /ˈæbsənt/ (adjective): not present. "Be absent from a session" means not there; "absent-minded" means forgetful.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where the PO invests the most time, even though the Scrum Guide does not list it as a formal event.", từ "formal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where the PO invests the most time, even though the Scrum Guide does not list it as a formal event.", what does "formal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: formal /ˈfɔːml/ (tính từ): chính thức. "A formal event" = sự kiện được quy định chính thức; "formal dress" là trang phục trang trọng.
items.explanationEn: formal /ˈfɔːml/ (adjective): officially defined. "A formal event" is officially defined; "formal dress" is the clothing sense.

items.question: Trong câu "At sprint review, the PO alone may declare an item", từ "declare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At sprint review, the PO alone may declare an item", what does "declare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: declare /dɪˈkleə/ (động từ): tuyên bố, công bố. "Declare something done" = chính thức tuyên bố là xong; trong lập trình "declare a variable" = khai báo biến.
items.explanationEn: declare /dɪˈkleə/ (verb): to state officially. "Declare something done" states it officially; in code you "declare a variable".

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance rests on two layers:", từ "rest on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance rests on two layers:", what does "rest on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rest on /rest ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên. "X rests on Y" = X dựa trên Y; trang trọng hơn "depends on".
items.explanationEn: rest on /rest ɒn/ (phrase): to be based on. "X rests on Y" means X is based on Y; more formal than "depends on".

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance rests on two layers:", từ "layer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance rests on two layers:", what does "layer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪə/ (danh từ): tầng, lớp. "Two layers of checks" = hai tầng kiểm tra; cũng dùng cho "layered architecture".
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪə/ (noun): a level or tier. "Two layers of checks" are two levels; compare "layered architecture".

items.question: Trong câu "Coded, reviewed, tested, integrated, documentation updated.", từ "integrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coded, reviewed, tested, integrated, documentation updated.", what does "integrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: integrate /ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/ (động từ): tích hợp. "Integrated" = đã ghép vào nhánh chính và chạy cùng hệ thống; "continuous integration" = tích hợp liên tục.
items.explanationEn: integrate /ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/ (verb): to combine into a whole. "Integrated" means merged and working with the rest; compare "continuous integration".

items.question: Trong câu "Agreed between team and PO in advance.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agreed between team and PO in advance.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): từ trước. "Agree in advance" = thống nhất trước; "pay in advance" = trả trước.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Agree in advance" means before the event; "pay in advance" is another use.

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance criteria — specific to each item.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance criteria — specific to each item.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪəriən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều là "criteria"; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí nghiệm thu.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪəriən/ (noun): a standard used for judging. The plural is "criteria"; "acceptance criteria" define when an item is accepted.

items.question: Trong câu "The concrete conditions describing expected behaviour.", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The concrete conditions describing expected behaviour.", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə/ (danh từ): hành vi, cách hoạt động. "Expected behaviour" = cách hệ thống được mong đợi hoạt động; Mỹ viết "behavior".
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə/ (noun): how a system acts. "Expected behaviour" is how the system should act; US spelling is "behavior".

items.question: Trong câu "Accepting partial work is the fastest way to destroy the meaning of velocity and every forecast built on it.", từ "partial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accepting partial work is the fastest way to destroy the meaning of velocity and every forecast built on it.", what does "partial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: partial /ˈpɑːʃl/ (tính từ): một phần, dở dang. "Partial work" = việc làm dở; "be partial to" là nghĩa khác: thiên vị, thích.
items.explanationEn: partial /ˈpɑːʃl/ (adjective): not complete. "Partial work" is unfinished; "be partial to" means to be fond of or biased.

items.question: Trong câu "Accepting partial work is the fastest way to destroy the meaning of velocity and every forecast built on it.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accepting partial work is the fastest way to destroy the meaning of velocity and every forecast built on it.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔːkɑːst/ (danh từ): dự báo. "A delivery forecast" = dự báo khi nào giao hàng; cũng dùng cho "weather forecast".
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔːkɑːst/ (noun): a prediction of the future. "A delivery forecast" predicts when work will ship; compare "weather forecast".

items.question: Trong câu "Reject on the spot with the reason recorded, rather than leaving it vague and arguing next sprint.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reject on the spot with the reason recorded, rather than leaving it vague and arguing next sprint.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ. "Leave it vague" = để mơ hồ; "vague requirements" = yêu cầu không rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear. "Vague requirements" are unclear and open to interpretation.

items.question: Trong câu "Reject on the spot with the reason recorded, rather than leaving it vague and arguing next sprint.", từ "argue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reject on the spot with the reason recorded, rather than leaving it vague and arguing next sprint.", what does "argue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: argue /ˈɑːɡjuː/ (động từ): tranh cãi. "Argue about something" = tranh cãi về điều gì; danh từ "argument".
items.explanationEn: argue /ˈɑːɡjuː/ (verb): to disagree in words. "Argue about something" means dispute it; the noun is "argument".

items.question: Trong câu "A misunderstanding?", từ "misunderstanding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A misunderstanding?", what does "misunderstanding" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstanding /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu lầm. "Clear up a misunderstanding" = làm rõ một hiểu lầm.
items.explanationEn: misunderstanding /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋ/ (noun): a failure to understand correctly. "Clear up a misunderstanding" means resolve it.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO unavailable during the sprint?", từ "unavailable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO unavailable during the sprint?", what does "unavailable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unavailable /ˌʌnəˈveɪləbl/ (tính từ): không liên lạc được, vắng. "Be unavailable" = không có mặt/không liên hệ được; "service unavailable" là dịch vụ không truy cập được.
items.explanationEn: unavailable /ˌʌnəˈveɪləbl/ (adjective): not free to be reached. "Be unavailable" means cannot be reached; "service unavailable" is a system sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The cause usually sits upstream, not with the developer.", từ "upstream" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cause usually sits upstream, not with the developer.", what does "upstream" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: at an earlier stage of a process
items.explanation: upstream /ˌʌpˈstriːm/ (trạng từ): ở khâu trước. "The cause sits upstream" = nguyên nhân nằm ở khâu trước (yêu cầu, AC); trái nghĩa "downstream".
items.explanationEn: upstream /ˌʌpˈstriːm/ (adverb): at an earlier stage of a process. "The cause sits upstream" means earlier in the process; the opposite is "downstream".

items.question: Trong câu "The sprint backlog belongs to the team.", từ "belong to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sprint backlog belongs to the team.", what does "belong to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): thuộc về. "X belongs to Y" = X thuộc quyền sở hữu/quản lý của Y.
items.explanationEn: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (phrase): to be owned by. "X belongs to Y" means Y owns or controls X.

items.question: Trong câu "If something is genuinely urgent, the correct move is negotiating an equivalent item out, or in the extreme case cancelling the sprint.", từ "negotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If something is genuinely urgent, the correct move is negotiating an equivalent item out, or in the extreme case cancelling the sprint.", what does "negotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: negotiate /nɪˈɡəʊʃieɪt/ (động từ): thương lượng. "Negotiate an item out" = thương lượng để bỏ một hạng mục ra; danh từ "negotiation".
items.explanationEn: negotiate /nɪˈɡəʊʃieɪt/ (verb): to discuss to reach agreement. "Negotiate an item out" means agree to remove it; the noun is "negotiation".

items.question: Trong câu "If something is genuinely urgent, the correct move is negotiating an equivalent item out, or in the extreme case cancelling the sprint.", từ "equivalent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If something is genuinely urgent, the correct move is negotiating an equivalent item out, or in the extreme case cancelling the sprint.", what does "equivalent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪvələnt/ (tính từ): tương đương. "An equivalent item" = hạng mục có khối lượng tương đương; "equivalent to" = tương đương với.
items.explanationEn: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪvələnt/ (adjective): equal in value or size. "An equivalent item" has similar size; "equivalent to" means equal to.

items.question: Trong câu "If something is genuinely urgent, the correct move is negotiating an equivalent item out, or in the extreme case cancelling the sprint.", từ "extreme" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If something is genuinely urgent, the correct move is negotiating an equivalent item out, or in the extreme case cancelling the sprint.", what does "extreme" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (tính từ): cực đoan, hiếm gặp nhất. "In the extreme case" = trong trường hợp cực đoan nhất.
items.explanationEn: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (adjective): most severe or unusual. "In the extreme case" means in the most serious situation.

items.question: Trong câu "Velocity is a forecasting tool, not a productivity target.", từ "productivity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: productivity /ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti/ (danh từ): năng suất. "Productivity target" = chỉ tiêu năng suất; tính từ "productive".
items.explanationEn: productivity /ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti/ (noun): the rate of output. "A productivity target" sets expected output; the adjective is "productive".

items.question: Trong câu "Velocity is a forecasting tool, not a productivity target.", từ "target" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Velocity is a forecasting tool, not a productivity target.", what does "target" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: target /ˈtɑːɡɪt/ (danh từ): chỉ tiêu, mục tiêu. "Hit/miss a target" = đạt/không đạt chỉ tiêu.
items.explanationEn: target /ˈtɑːɡɪt/ (noun): a goal to reach. "Hit a target" means reach a goal; "miss a target" means fail to.

items.question: Trong câu "Turn it into a target and the team inflates estimates, and you lose the forecasting tool entirely.", từ "inflate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Turn it into a target and the team inflates estimates, and you lose the forecasting tool entirely.", what does "inflate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (động từ): thổi phồng. "Inflate estimates" = cố tình ước lượng cao hơn thực tế; nghĩa gốc là bơm phồng.
items.explanationEn: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (verb): to make larger than real. "Inflate estimates" means make them bigger on purpose; the literal sense is fill with air.

items.question: Trong câu "Turn it into a target and the team inflates estimates, and you lose the forecasting tool entirely.", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Turn it into a target and the team inflates estimates, and you lose the forecasting tool entirely.", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈestɪmət/ (danh từ): ước lượng. Danh từ /ˈestɪmət/, động từ /ˈestɪmeɪt/; "rough estimate" = ước lượng sơ bộ.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈestɪmət/ (noun): an approximate calculation. Noun /ˈestɪmət/, verb /ˈestɪmeɪt/; a "rough estimate" is approximate.

items.question: Trong câu "Turn it into a target and the team inflates estimates, and you lose the forecasting tool entirely.", từ "entirely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Turn it into a target and the team inflates estimates, and you lose the forecasting tool entirely.", what does "entirely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪəli/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn. "Lose something entirely" = mất hoàn toàn.
items.explanationEn: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪəli/ (adverb): completely. "Lose something entirely" means lose it completely.

items.question: Trong câu "A blocked team guesses, and wrong guesses mean rework.", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A blocked team guesses, and wrong guesses mean rework.", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriːwɜːk/ (danh từ): việc phải làm lại. "Rework" = làm lại vì sai, là lãng phí cần tránh.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriːwɜːk/ (noun): work redone to fix mistakes. "Rework" is work redone because of errors, a waste to avoid.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO who imposes a technical solution both usurps the team and loses the better idea.", từ "usurp" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO who imposes a technical solution both usurps the team and loses the better idea.", what does "usurp" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take someone's role without right
items.explanation: usurp /juːˈzɜːp/ (động từ): chiếm quyền, lấn quyền. Từ trang trọng: chiếm đoạt vai trò/quyền của người khác.
items.explanationEn: usurp /juːˈzɜːp/ (verb): to take someone's role without right. A formal word for taking another person's role or power.

items.question: Trong câu "Protects a sustainable pace", từ "sustainable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Protects a sustainable pace", what does "sustainable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be kept up long-term
items.explanation: sustainable /səˈsteɪnəbl/ (tính từ): bền vững, duy trì được. "Sustainable pace" = nhịp làm việc có thể duy trì lâu mà không kiệt sức.
items.explanationEn: sustainable /səˈsteɪnəbl/ (adjective): able to be kept up long-term. "Sustainable pace" is a work rate a team can keep without burning out.

items.question: Trong câu "Protects a sustainable pace", từ "pace" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Protects a sustainable pace", what does "pace" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pace /peɪs/ (danh từ): nhịp độ, tốc độ. "Keep pace with" = theo kịp; "at a steady pace" = với nhịp đều.
items.explanationEn: pace /peɪs/ (noun): speed of progress. "Keep pace with" means keep up; "at a steady pace" means evenly.

items.question: Trong câu "The two roles are DELIBERATELY in tension.", từ "tension" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two roles are DELIBERATELY in tension.", what does "tension" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tension /ˈtenʃn/ (danh từ): sự căng thẳng, giằng co. "In tension" = hai bên kéo về hai hướng khác nhau, tạo cân bằng.
items.explanationEn: tension /ˈtenʃn/ (noun): a pull between opposing forces. "In tension" means pulling in opposite directions, creating balance.

items.question: Trong câu "Merging them removes the check: a PO who is also SM will always favour schedule over the team's health.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merging them removes the check: a PO who is also SM will always favour schedule over the team's health.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): gộp lại. "Merge two roles/branches" = gộp hai vai trò/nhánh làm một.
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge two roles" combines them; in Git you "merge branches".

items.question: Trong câu "Merging them removes the check: a PO who is also SM will always favour schedule over the team's health.", từ "check" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merging them removes the check: a PO who is also SM will always favour schedule over the team's health.", what does "check" (noun) mean?
options: cơ chế kiểm soát, kiềm chế
items.explanation: check /tʃek/ (danh từ): cơ chế kiểm soát, kiềm chế. "Checks and balances" = cơ chế kiểm soát lẫn nhau giữa các bên.
items.explanationEn: check /tʃek/ (noun): a control that limits power. "Checks and balances" are controls that stop one side dominating.

items.question: Trong câu "Merging them removes the check: a PO who is also SM will always favour schedule over the team's health.", từ "favour" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merging them removes the check: a PO who is also SM will always favour schedule over the team's health.", what does "favour" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: favour /ˈfeɪvə/ (động từ): ưu ái, thiên về. "Favour A over B" = ưu tiên A hơn B; danh từ "do someone a favour" = giúp ai.
items.explanationEn: favour /ˈfeɪvə/ (verb): to prefer. "Favour A over B" means prefer A; "do someone a favour" is the helping sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Two people ordering a backlog is a recipe for chaos.", từ "recipe for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two people ordering a backlog is a recipe for chaos.", what does "recipe for" (phrase) mean?
options: nguyên nhân chắc chắn dẫn tới
items.explanation: recipe for /ˈresəpi fɔː/ (cụm từ): nguyên nhân chắc chắn dẫn tới. "A recipe for disaster/chaos" = điều chắc chắn dẫn tới thảm hoạ/hỗn loạn.
items.explanationEn: recipe for /ˈresəpi fɔː/ (phrase): something certain to cause. "A recipe for disaster" is something bound to cause trouble.

items.question: Trong câu "Two people ordering a backlog is a recipe for chaos.", từ "chaos" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two people ordering a backlog is a recipe for chaos.", what does "chaos" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: chaos /ˈkeɪɒs/ (danh từ): sự hỗn loạn. Phát âm /ˈkeɪɒs/; tính từ "chaotic".
items.explanationEn: chaos /ˈkeɪɒs/ (noun): complete disorder. Pronounced /ˈkeɪɒs/; the adjective is "chaotic".

items.question: Trong câu "What is mandatory is that ordering authority sits with exactly one person.", từ "sit with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is mandatory is that ordering authority sits with exactly one person.", what does "sit with" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: sit with /sɪt wɪð/ (cụm từ): thuộc về, nằm ở. "Authority/responsibility sits with X" = quyền/trách nhiệm thuộc về X.
items.explanationEn: sit with /sɪt wɪð/ (phrase): to be held by. "Authority sits with X" means X holds it.

items.question: Trong câu "When the team spans time zones:", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the team spans time zones:", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải dài qua. "Span time zones/years" = trải qua nhiều múi giờ/năm; danh từ "time span" = khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. "Span time zones" means stretch across them; a "time span" is a period.

items.question: Trong câu "Increase acceptance criteria detail to compensate for not being able to ask immediately.", từ "compensate for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Increase acceptance criteria detail to compensate for not being able to ask immediately.", what does "compensate for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: compensate for /ˈkɒmpenseɪt fɔː/ (cụm từ): bù đắp cho. "Compensate for a weakness" = bù đắp cho điểm yếu; "compensation" còn là lương thưởng.
items.explanationEn: compensate for /ˈkɒmpenseɪt fɔː/ (phrase): to make up for. "Compensate for a weakness" makes up for it; "compensation" can also mean pay.

items.question: Trong câu "Guarantee one overlapping hour each day to clear blocking questions.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guarantee one overlapping hour each day to clear blocking questions.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (động từ): bảo đảm. "Guarantee an hour" = đảm bảo chắc chắn có một giờ; danh từ "guarantee" = sự bảo đảm.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (verb): to make certain. "Guarantee an hour" means make sure it happens; the noun is also "guarantee".

items.question: Trong câu "Guarantee one overlapping hour each day to clear blocking questions.", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guarantee one overlapping hour each day to clear blocking questions.", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cover part of the same time
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lấn, trùng nhau. "Overlapping hours" = khung giờ hai múi giờ cùng làm việc.
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (verb): to cover part of the same time. "Overlapping hours" are when both time zones are working.

items.question: Trong câu "One single product backlog for the product — parallel backlogs create contradictory priorities.", từ "parallel" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One single product backlog for the product — parallel backlogs create contradictory priorities.", what does "parallel" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: parallel /ˈpærəlel/ (tính từ): song song. "Parallel backlogs" = nhiều backlog tồn tại song song; "run in parallel" = chạy song song.
items.explanationEn: parallel /ˈpærəlel/ (adjective): existing side by side. "Parallel backlogs" exist side by side; "run in parallel" means at the same time.

items.question: Trong câu "One single product backlog for the product — parallel backlogs create contradictory priorities.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One single product backlog for the product — parallel backlogs create contradictory priorities.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪktəri/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Contradictory priorities" = các ưu tiên mâu thuẫn; động từ "contradict".
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪktəri/ (adjective): conflicting with each other. "Contradictory priorities" conflict; the verb is "contradict".

items.question: Trong câu "One PO ultimately accountable, possibly with area POs supporting each team.", từ "ultimately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One PO ultimately accountable, possibly with area POs supporting each team.", what does "ultimately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ultimately /ˈʌltɪmətli/ (trạng từ): sau cùng, rốt cuộc. "Ultimately accountable" = người chịu trách nhiệm cuối cùng.
items.explanationEn: ultimately /ˈʌltɪmətli/ (adverb): in the end, finally. "Ultimately accountable" means the final person answerable.

items.question: Trong câu "One PO ultimately accountable, possibly with area POs supporting each team.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One PO ultimately accountable, possibly with area POs supporting each team.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm giải trình. "Be accountable for X" = phải chịu trách nhiệm và giải trình về X; danh từ "accountability".
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (adjective): answerable for results. "Be accountable for X" means you answer for X; the noun is "accountability".

items.question: Trong câu "Cross-team dependencies must surface early, usually via a shared refinement session.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cross-team dependencies must surface early, usually via a shared refinement session.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. "Issues surface" = vấn đề lộ ra; danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to come to light. "Issues surface" means they become known; the noun "surface" is the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Cross-team dependencies must surface early, usually via a shared refinement session.", từ "via" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cross-team dependencies must surface early, usually via a shared refinement session.", what does "via" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: via /ˈvaɪə/ (giới từ): thông qua. "Via email/a meeting" = thông qua email/cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: via /ˈvaɪə/ (preposition): by means of. "Via email" means by means of email.

items.question: Trong câu "Beyond that the PO becomes a bottleneck and teams start guessing.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beyond that the PO becomes a bottleneck and teams start guessing.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the neck of a glass bottle
a point that slows the whole flow

items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (noun): a point that slows the whole flow. "Become a bottleneck" means slow the whole flow down.

items.question: Trong câu "Beyond that the PO becomes a bottleneck and teams start guessing.", từ "beyond" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beyond that the PO becomes a bottleneck and teams start guessing.", what does "beyond" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: beyond /bɪˈjɒnd/ (giới từ): vượt quá, ngoài. "Beyond that" = vượt quá mức đó; "beyond our control" = ngoài tầm kiểm soát.
items.explanationEn: beyond /bɪˈjɒnd/ (preposition): past a limit. "Beyond that" means past that limit; "beyond our control" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO should attend retrospectives but must step out if their presence stops candour.", từ "candour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO should attend retrospectives but must step out if their presence stops candour.", what does "candour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: candour /ˈkændə/ (danh từ): sự thẳng thắn. Chính tả Mỹ "candor"; tính từ "candid" = thẳng thắn.
items.explanationEn: candour /ˈkændə/ (noun): openness and honesty. US spelling is "candor"; the adjective is "candid".

items.question: Trong câu "The PO should attend retrospectives but must step out if their presence stops candour.", từ "step out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO should attend retrospectives but must step out if their presence stops candour.", what does "step out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: step out /step aʊt/ (cụm từ): rời đi, không tham gia. "Step out of a meeting" = tạm rời cuộc họp; trái với "step in" (can thiệp).
items.explanationEn: step out /step aʊt/ (phrase): to leave for a while. "Step out of a meeting" means leave it; compare "step in" (intervene).

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance must be decisive and based on criteria agreed beforehand, or every forecast loses meaning.", từ "decisive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance must be decisive and based on criteria agreed beforehand, or every forecast loses meaning.", what does "decisive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: decisive /dɪˈsaɪsɪv/ (tính từ): dứt khoát. "Be decisive" = quyết đoán, không lưỡng lự; danh từ "decision".
items.explanationEn: decisive /dɪˈsaɪsɪv/ (adjective): firm and clear. "Be decisive" means make firm choices quickly; the noun is "decision".

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance must be decisive and based on criteria agreed beforehand, or every forecast loses meaning.", từ "beforehand" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance must be decisive and based on criteria agreed beforehand, or every forecast loses meaning.", what does "beforehand" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: beforehand /bɪˈfɔːhænd/ (trạng từ): từ trước. Đồng nghĩa "in advance"; thường đứng cuối câu.
items.explanationEn: beforehand /bɪˈfɔːhænd/ (adverb): in advance. A synonym of "in advance", usually placed at the end.

items.question: Trong câu "preparing well for refinement is the cheapest way to make every other event run smoothly.", từ "smoothly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "preparing well for refinement is the cheapest way to make every other event run smoothly.", what does "smoothly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: smoothly /ˈsmuːðli/ (trạng từ): trơn tru, suôn sẻ. "Run smoothly" = diễn ra suôn sẻ, không trục trặc.
items.explanationEn: smoothly /ˈsmuːðli/ (adverb): without problems. "Run smoothly" means go well without problems.
